==Acquisition==
Temporarily, as one of the five skills available while under the effect of [[Volfen Blessing]].

==Related skills==
*{{skill icon|Volfen Agility (Curse of the Nornbear)}}

==Notes==
*While affected by a [[Quickening Zephyr]] spirit, you will be able to maintain this skill indefinitely  after the first cast with rank 3 or higher. This will allow you to also indefinitely maintain [[Volfen Bloodlust]] and use the Volfen attack skills more frequently.
